name: tee-studio
description: Put your own artwork on a custom T-shirt inside ChatGPT: see a mockup, price and print-quality check, then check out.

interface.shortDescription: Print your art on a custom tee
interface.longDescription:
Tee Studio is part of the Marvel At That Studio series. It turns your own artwork into a custom T-shirt without leaving ChatGPT.

Attach an image, or use one you have just created with ChatGPT, then choose a colour, size and print size. Tee Studio shows a mockup of your design on the shirt, an automatic print-quality check (with a warning if the image is too small to print sharply), and the price in your own currency. Shipping to selected international destinations is free and included in the price.

Before checkout, you confirm in the card that you own the image or have the rights to print it. Checkout opens on the Marvel At That shop; payment is processed in South African rand, and your bank converts it to your currency.

Tee Studio works with Design Studio and Mockup Studio from the same series. Designs are checked against a content policy before printing.

Limitations: orders from South Africa are coming soon. Image generation and edits use ChatGPT's own capabilities, so results can vary; always review your design before ordering.
capabilities: Place your image on a tee mockup
defaultPrompt: Put this design on a black tee, size L.
Show me the T-shirt colours and prices.
Make a tee from the image I just created.

positive.description: Browse colours and prices in local currency
positive.prompt: What T-shirt colours and sizes do you have, and how much are they in the UK?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the available colours and sizes with prices in GBP and free international shipping.

positive.prompt: Put this design on a black tee, size L, shipping to the United Kingdom. (attach a PNG)
positive.expected_behavior: A card shows the design on a black tee, a GBP price with a note that the charge is in rand, and a print-quality result. Checkout stays disabled until the rights box is ticked.

positive.prompt: In the card from the previous case, tick 'I own this image or have the rights to print it'.
positive.expected_behavior: Checkout becomes enabled and opens the shop checkout with the design in the cart. No payment is needed for review; the tick stays set after further messages.

positive.prompt: Create a roaring golden lion head in bold vector style, then put it on a black tee, size L, shipping to the United States.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT generates the art; the card shows it on a black tee with a USD price and the print-quality result.

positive.prompt: Is my tee design ready to order?
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows the current status with the same mockup and price.

negative.prompt: Can I order one to Nigeria?
Find me cheaper band T-shirts from other stores.
Charge my card for the tee now.

review.commerce_description: Sells custom-printed T-shirts made from the customer's own image. Tee Studio shows a mockup and price; payment happens on the Marvel At That shop's checkout page, not inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: custom tees from your own image with mockup, print-quality check, local-currency prices, in-card rights confirmation and checkout.
